answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding one active identity per carrier-KYC subscriber. The ledger hashes the government ID and rejects a second registration for that hash; each epoch the agent must answer a fresh nonce sent to that subscriber's SIM, accepted only with a carrier-signed delivery attestation. Whether the phone sits on a knoll, in a grove, or in a meadow, each extra identity still needs a live KYC check and a SIM plan, so total reward is n(R-C), deterring only while R<C.
